name: Mars Relay: Unknown Signal
description: A Mars rover telemetry relay has gone quiet, and its ground station is answering with an unfamiliar signal. On the lab network, find the relay among the hosts in 172.20.0.0/24 (challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199) and recover the archived telemetry record.

tasks.name: Recover the telemetry record
tasks.description: The rover's relay is on the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24 (challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199), identify the relay by its responses, and recover the archived telemetry record.
hints: One listener is using an unexpected port. Pay attention to how it behaves when you connect.
The relay speaks MQTT. Consider what a client does after it establishes a session with a broker.
Subscribe to the rover's telemetry archive and inspect the retained record delivered by the broker.
